summary: The PR fixes an issue where `sub_connect_graph.nodes` was being called without parentheses, and wraps a blocking `delete` call in `trio.to_thread.run_sync`. It also corrects an attribute merging logic in `Extractor` to handle cases where attributes might be missing and uses proper sorting for merged lists.

findings.message: L204: 🔴 bug: `list.extend()` returns `None`, so `sorted(set(None))` will raise an error. Directly use `set.update()` or concatenate and convert to set for merging lists.
L218: 🔴 bug: `list.extend()` returns `None`, so `set(None)` will raise an error. Directly use `set.update()` or concatenate and convert to set for merging lists.
